braces: development-tool security patch
======================================

This directory contains braces 3.0.3 with the source changes proposed in
micromatch/braces pull request 72 by FSDevelop. The original MIT license and
copyright are preserved in LICENSE. The package is private and identified as
3.0.3-darklab.1; it is not an upstream release.

Original package: https://registry.npmjs.org/braces/-/braces-3.0.3.tgz
Original source: https://github.com/micromatch/braces/tree/3.0.3
Security advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm
Proposed patch: https://github.com/micromatch/braces/pull/72
Patch commit: d0d575e55e74a4e0218e5248fafb79efc3e54ebb

security.patch contains that commit's changes to lib/ only, applied to the
published 3.0.3 package. index.js and the remaining lib/ files are unchanged.
The local package metadata preserves upstream attribution and runtime
dependencies and adds the private patch version and source reference.

The patch limits brace and parenthesis nesting to 100 levels in the parser
and recursive compile, expand, and stringify paths. A caller can request a
lower maxDepth, but cannot raise it above the safety limit. The limit also
covers callers that supply an AST directly.

The root package.json installs this directory as a development dependency
and overrides every transitive braces dependency to the same local package.
It is used by Markdown and CSS lint tooling, not the application browser
bundles or released container. npm audit does not scan linked local source;
audit:js therefore runs the installed-dependency security regressions before
the unchanged npm audit --audit-level=high check. Registry dependencies,
including fill-range, remain in the ordinary dependency audit.

Maintenance and validation are documented in CONTRIBUTING.md under
"Linting and Security Scanning". Run npm ci, npm run audit:js, npm run lint:md,
and npm run lint:css when changing this package or its dependency override.
